title: Vietnam Seafood Export Quality
thesis: On one governed platform, Snowflake turns daily consignment activity from 40 fictional Vietnamese seafood exporters into export quality KPIs, a 7-day import rejection risk score per exporter, document discrepancy anomalies and AI answers that cite their sources.

talking_points: 40 fictional seafood exporters ship whiteleg shrimp, black tiger shrimp, pangasius fillet, frozen squid and canned tuna from Ca Mau, Can Tho, Long Xuyen, Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; the cards show clean consignment rate, consignment issues, import rejections and export value in USD.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so each card traces back to exporter-day rows.

The issue-type chart separates issues that often end in an import rejection, such as health certificate mismatches and glazing net weight shortfalls, from storm port closures that are always resolved.
tabs.call_out: Seafood export KPIs you can trace to source rows

transition.line: Which processing plants need a quality review before their next reefer sails?

talking_points: A Snowflake ML classifier estimates, per exporter, the chance of an import rejection in the next 7 days.
Precision and recall come from the most recent labelled days held out of training, shown next to the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags unusual export document discrepancy rates, and the forecast covers the next 14 days of consignment issues so the quality desk can plan staffing.
tabs.call_out: ML that is evaluated honestly, next to the data

transition.line: Are plants keeping residue lab tests and export documents in order?

talking_points: Residue lab test compliance, export document coverage and pending documents show where plant controls are slipping.
Plotting residue lab test compliance against import rejections per exporter shows where the two move together; that is an association, not a cause.
The action memo proposes three prioritised actions using only the KPI, exporter, issue-type and risk rows.
show: Residue lab test compliance and document coverage
Lab test compliance vs import rejections
tabs.call_out: Draft actions grounded in data, reviewed by a person

transition.line: What happens when a reefer consignment hits a problem right now?

talking_points: New reefer shipment events arrive in RAW.LIVE_SHIPMENTS, from the simulator or from an Amazon Data Firehose stream through Snowpipe.
The alert records each ISSUE event with an SOP hint and the exporter risk band, then emails the on-call seafood export quality analyst.
tabs.call_out: From a live consignment issue to an exporter case on one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers metric questions with Cortex Analyst over the semantic view, and procedure questions with Cortex Search over 13 synthetic seafood consignment-issue SOPs.
Every answer shows the SQL it generated and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Plain-language answers that you can check

transition.line: This is how it fits together.

talking_points: One core supports two builds: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake with Amazon Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q.
All data shown is synthetic and rebuilds the same way from the repo.
